cipher_bundle.name: VigenereCipherWithFixedKey

description_json.name: Vigenere Cipher with Fixed Key
description_json.idea: Apply a classic Vigenere cipher using the fixed repeating key 'CIPHER'. This shifts each alphabetic character based on the corresponding letter of the key, preserving case. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each character in the plaintext: 1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it forward by the value of the corresponding key letter (A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25), wrapping around the alphabet. 2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it forward in the same manner, preserving lowercase. 3. If it is a digit, punctuation, space, or other symbol, leave it unchanged. 4. The key is 'CIPHER' (case-insensitive, values: C=2, I=8, P=15, H=7, E=4, R=17). The key index only advances when an alphabetic character is encrypted.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each character in the ciphertext: 1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it backward by the value of the corresponding key letter (A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25), wrapping around the alphabet. 2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it backward in the same manner, preserving lowercase. 3. If it is a digit, punctuation, space, or other symbol, leave it unchanged. 4. The key is 'CIPHER' (values: C=2, I=8, P=15, H=7, E=4, R=17). The key index only advances when an alphabetic character is decrypted.

ciphers.name: qwerty

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
